title: Tragedy Hits Georgia Homecoming: 2 Dead, Dozens Wounded in Mass Shooting
snippet: A midnight homecoming event in small-town Georgia turned deadly early Sunday when gunfire broke out, killing two young men and injuring 35 others.
content:
A festive homecoming celebration in central Georgia erupted into violence early Sunday morning, leaving two young men dead and 35 others injured after gunfire tore through a crowd of partygoers.

The shooting took place on Pine Street in Vienna, a small community located in Dooly County, roughly two hours south of Atlanta. According to Dooly County Sheriff Craig Peavy, an estimated 1,000 people had gathered for the festivities following Saturday night's events when panic ensued.

A Horrific Scene in Vienna

Authorities reported that shots were fired directly into a group of approximately 50 people within the larger crowd. Dooly County Coroner Brett Walls described the scene as "horrific," confirming that two victims—a 20-year-old man and a 23-year-old man—succumbed to fatal gunshot wounds.

Dozens of attendees fled for safety as shots rang out. Emergency personnel rushed to the area, with initial reports indicating at least 25 individuals were transported to regional hospitals for urgent medical care.

State and Local Authorities Investigate

The Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI) was brought in to assist the Dooly County Sheriff’s Office with the processing of the crime scene and the ongoing inquiry. On Sunday morning, state officials confirmed the total count of injured individuals had climbed to 35.

As of late Sunday, law enforcement has not publicly identified any suspects, nor have they released details regarding a potential motive behind the deadly incident. The investigation remains active.
